protocol.purpose: paired designed middle-frame ten-detection four-slot/eight-frame absolute audit
protocol.reference_method: exact canonical interval-mask multiset sum with permutation multiplicity; independent combinatorial support derivation; directly checked one-slot GP likelihood lookup and selected direct collapsed scores; endpoint rate and eleven analytic base-normalizer checks; both references before sampler
protocol.rate_selection: per observation maximize min(exact P(A), P(B)); tie to lower rate
protocol.difficulty_validation: both observations: selected exact A/B >=0.10 and beta=0.5 B <= half beta=1 B; if either fails, stop all sampler inference
protocol.joint_cells: 33 alive totals by 3 added-middle clutter by 3 frame-six clutter by 3 final-frame clutter: 891 cells in each case
protocol.comparison: per-run 4D joint TV, maximum mode and cell errors versus 1000 exact IID multinomial q95 per case and particle count; also 3D collapsed joint, alive and three clutter means; six-run mean signed 4D and collapsed 3D cells versus familywise q95 from 1000 exact groups of six
protocol.persistence_rule: at 2048 particles: persistent_mode_tail and persistent_joint_tail require >=2/6 q95 exceedances in both cases; shared_cell_shift requires the same collapsed 3D (alive, frame-six clutter, final clutter) cell to exceed each familywise six-run mean q95 with the same sign; designed cases share nine observations and are dependent
protocol.run_order: early reference then middle reference; early 512/2048 seeds 1180..1185; middle 512/2048 seeds 1190..1195
protocol.interpretation: designed ten-detection middle-frame bridge; descriptive IID references, not independent population replication or WP11k 19-detection calibration; no move selection, 8192 or untouched holdout
